GLMM Analysis Report

Methods

Model was fitted using afex::mixed.

Family: gaussian

Formula: Reaction ~ Days + (Days || Subject)

Sample size used in this fit: 18 subjects, 180 observations.

Model Fitting Diagnostics

This section reports diagnostics captured automatically at fit time and should be reviewed before interpreting the results below. A singular fit, a non-convergence message, or fitting warnings do not necessarily invalidate a model, but they do mean its estimates (particularly variance components) should be interpreted with caution.

How to read these measures

  • R2 marginal: proportion of variance explained by the fixed effects alone.
  • R2 conditional: proportion of variance explained by the fixed and random effects together.
  • ICC: proportion of the total (non-fixed-effect) variance attributable to differences between groups/subjects; higher values mean observations within the same group are more alike.
  • This model was fitted by REML: AIC/BIC are only comparable between models with identical fixed effects. Refit by ML to compare models with different fixed effects.
